description: Not a lever of the fused stack: the lone-user padded round (QWEN_FAST_SOLO_PACKED=1, gate only, default off). A lone live user (and a lone user of the other M3 block) decodes on the 64-row packed block with its idle segments padded, instead of on its own 4-row engine. The third idle segment needs a (page, tile row) nothing else owns, and the only physical one is a KV block past vLLM's pool: idle_scratch.py makes the worker's KV cache tensors one block longer (a PostImportHook on the model entry, armed at boot by the flag alone), the cache owner claims it and keeps the pool's bound for requests, and the packed block sends its third idle segment to it. Its two gate-only twins (-fx-s4-np1 and -fx-s4-np1-audit of the approved ship-4 profile) are generated by make_np1_profiles.py; its window is references/fusion-jobs/NP1 (make_np1_jobs.py). Unset (the default) nothing moves.

image_files.reason: serving_c2_contract imports it at boot once QWEN_FAST_SOLO_PACKED is set (the allocation hook on the model entry), and serving_cache_owner and serving_octo import it lazily with the flag set; an image without it refuses that boot

notes: Shared files this package edits, as the integrator of the NP1 window: packed_verifier.py (idle_scratch_pages: two more idle targets a scratch page, fail-closed on a live table that names one), serving_cache_owner.py (the claim), serving_octo.py (the solo-packed admission counts the page), serving_runtime.py (hands the pages to the two M3 blocks), serving_c2_contract.py (arms the hook at boot), c2_serving_smoke.py (the opt-in np1_live1/2/4 shapes), and the census tests that exempt generated twins. Every change is off unless QWEN_FAST_SOLO_PACKED=1.
